purpose: U12: smoke test of scientific-compute on at least 3 CPU host classes (a CPU-only Kit: runs with no --gpus)
gpu_models_note: This Kit uses no GPU (kit.json resource_defaults.gpu_count 0, so smoke_runner passes no --gpus). host_classes_required names three distinct CPU host classes ('cpu' labels, one per self-hosted runner label cpu-a, cpu-b, cpu-c in .github/workflows/kits.yml) whose CPUs are compared. The fleet is the owner's decision. Platform side: placing such a job needs CPU_ONLY_KITS_ENABLED (see kits/README.md).

fixture.how: python make_fixture.py script.py  (writes a small deterministic numpy/scipy/pandas script)

checks.expect: container exit code 0 and output.json ok=true
results/summary.json and results/table.csv exist; logs/determinism.json says deterministic true
re-run on the same host gives byte-identical outputs (exact_deterministic status 'passed')
outputs of different host classes: record whether they are byte-identical (CPU float results may differ; owner decides)
run with --network none succeeds; a script that opens a socket fails inside the sandbox
a script with an endless loop and timeout_seconds 2 ends with script_timeout and no stray processes
a non-Python or syntactically invalid script is refused with invalid_input before anything runs
